Method of Attack: Malware installed as a DLL backdoor connecting to C&C server via HTTPS to download and execute modules
Modules include data exfiltration, subversion of local software, and internal services
Subversion modules can delay, kill, or lock up processes based on configuration
Nagware style sabotage of user software (e.g., killing browser processes, delaying PowerPoint)
Attack Vector: DLL backdoor installed on target PC
Indicators of Compromise: Connection to C&C server via HTTPS
Killing Internet Explorer and Firefox executables every 30 seconds
